entries.title: Conscientious Objection
entries.unresolved_review_note: No MCC objective (Medical Expert or role-level) was found that explicitly or substantially addresses conscientious objection. Professional role's 'Integrity' group covers general ethical conduct but does not name this topic. Flagged UNCERTAIN rather than force-mapped to a weakly-related objective.

entries.mapping_rationale: No MCC objective addresses thrombocytosis directly; objective 15-2's thrombosis-risk-assessment scope is the only loosely adjacent evidence found, since marked thrombocytosis (esp. clonal) carries a thrombotic risk, but the objective's own text and title describe venous-thrombosis prevention generally, not a platelet-count abnormality.
